prompt: Tessa wrote that the lemon cake recipe used (too much / too many) sugar.
explanation_ru: «Sugar» — неисчисляемое существительное, поэтому для значения «слишком много» выбираем «too much».

prompt: Our mountain lodge does not have (some / any) fresh milk left for breakfast.
explanation_ru: В отрицательном предложении перед неисчисляемым «milk» употребляется «any», а не «some».

prompt: Alice felt hot because there was very (few / little) wind in the valley.
explanation_ru: «Wind» здесь обозначает неисчисляемое явление погоды, поэтому со словом «very» используется «little».

prompt: "Do you know how (much / many) sugar hides inside three sweet breakfast drinks?"
explanation_ru: Чтобы спросить о количестве неисчисляемого «sugar», используется «how much», а не «how many».

prompt: Diego poured (a few / a little) hot red sauce on his three burgers.
explanation_ru: «Sauce» — неисчисляемое вещество, поэтому для значения «немного» выбираем «a little».

prompt: Kenji likes his Kyoto flat because the quiet street has almost no (traffic).
explanation_ru: «Traffic» (дорожное движение) — неисчисляемое существительное, оно всегда стоит в единственном числе без окончания «-s».

prompt: Bruno messaged his boss that road repairs left (fewer / less) open (lane) than usual, causing a long delay.
explanation_ru: Полосы движения («lanes») исчисляемы во множественном числе, поэтому для значения «меньше» требуется «fewer».

prompt: During dark winter months, I get (fewer / less) (sleep) than I should, so I walk outside after lunch.
explanation_ru: «Sleep» (сон) — неисчисляемое существительное, поэтому с ним используется сравнительная степень «less».

prompt: Audrey told the town meeting that the narrow lane behind her bookshop does not have (no / any) street (lighting) after six.
explanation_ru: После отрицания «does not» нужно «any», а «lighting» (освещение) — неисчисляемое существительное без формы множественного числа.

prompt: "I worry that I have almost zero computer (experience), though five local workshops (be) looking for teachers."
explanation_ru: «Experience» в значении «опыт работы» неисчисляемое (без «-s»), а «five workshops» — множественное число, требующее «are».

prompt: Gemma checked the car in her Bristol garage and noticed that the brake (oil) (be) dangerously low before the weekend trip.
explanation_ru: «Oil» (масло, жидкость) — неисчисляемое существительное, поэтому в прошедшем времени с ним согласуется форма единственного числа «was».

prompt: My two children love the bright (swing) at Portland Park, yet the hot playground provides almost zero (shade) in July.
explanation_ru: Качели на площадке исчисляемы во множественном числе («swings»), тогда как «shade» (тень) — неисчисляемое существительное.

prompt: Because Seville received a tiny (number / amount) of (rain) this summer, thick dust on the roof panels reduced the building's electricity output by twenty per cent.
explanation_ru: Перед неисчисляемым «rain» употребляется «amount of», а «number of» используется только с исчисляемыми существительными.

prompt: Zanele sent an urgent email to her producer after a sudden power cut erased her recorded (work) before she could save a single backup (file).
explanation_ru: «Work» в значении «проделанная работа» неисчисляемое, а после «a single» нужно исчисляемое существительное в единственном числе («file»).

prompt: Although our university archive holds valuable old maps, our dry (storage) (have) already run out, leaving us in urgent need of twelve flat wooden drawers.
explanation_ru: «Storage» (место для хранения) — неисчисляемое существительное, поэтому в Present Perfect используется вспомогательный глагол «has».

prompt: Before Saturday's river race in Cambridge, the rowing coach reminded the young crew that calm (patience) (matter) far more than raw speed during sharp turns.
explanation_ru: Абстрактное существительное «patience» (терпение) неисчисляемое, поэтому глагол в Present Simple принимает окончание «-s» («matters»).

prompt: Mateo had a cooking test at a bakery in Marseille. The basket held fresh (butter) and six brown (egg). The white flour (look) very soft on the table. However, there was no scale in the kitchen!
explanation_ru: «Butter» и «flour» — неисчисляемые продукты («flour» требует глагол «looks»), а «six eggs» — исчисляемое во множественном числе.

prompt: Dad made Sunday breakfast in our Toronto kitchen. By mistake, he poured double the (milk) into the mixing bowl. Soon we had twenty-four warm (pancake) on three plates. The leftover food (stay) in the freezer for school mornings.
explanation_ru: «Milk» неисчисляемое, блины считают поштучно («twenty-four pancakes»), а неисчисляемое «food» требует глагол в единственном числе («stays»).

prompt: Our school group spent Saturday morning cleaning a beach in Cape Town. Within two hours, we filled thirty-five big bags with plastic (bottle) and lost sandals. The collected (rubbish) (sit) neatly beside the road for the council lorry. By midday, the white sand looked clean again.
explanation_ru: Бутылки исчисляемы («bottles»), а «rubbish» (мусор) — неисчисляемое существительное, поэтому с ним употребляется глагол «sits».

prompt: "Excuse me, could someone check our wooden cabin?" asked Einar at reception. "We counted ten soft (cushion) on the sofa, yet there are only two coat hooks by the door. Even worse, our dry (wood) (have) already run out, and the wind is freezing tonight." The clerk promised to send help straight away.
explanation_ru: Подушки исчисляемы («ten cushions»), тогда как «wood» (дрова) в английском языке неисчисляемое и требует форму «has».

prompt: Dear Parents, please check the lost-property box at our Zurich school before the winter holiday. Yesterday I sorted fourteen single (glove) and six metal water bottles from the hallway shelves. Can anyone also claim a shiny red violin case? All this unclaimed (clothing) (take) up half of my small office!
explanation_ru: Отдельные перчатки исчисляемы («fourteen gloves»), а собирательное «clothing» (одежда) неисчисляемое и требует глагол «takes».

prompt: "Why can't astronauts shake ordinary (salt) over their dinner in space?" asked a curious boy at the Houston museum. The guide smiled and held up two sealed food (bag). "Loose dust floats everywhere inside the station and easily (damage) the computer fans," she explained. "Instead, the crew adds liquid flavouring to their meals."
explanation_ru: «Salt» неисчисляемое, пакеты для еды исчисляемы («two pouches»), а неисчисляемое «dust» согласуется с глаголом «damages».

prompt: While locking up the Melbourne biology lab after evening classes, Owen spotted a frustrating mess beside the main sink. Somebody had used nearly all the clean glass (jar) without washing them for the morning group. Worse still, two (litre / soap) had spilled across the floor, and the damp (equipment) near the tap (need) drying straight away. Owen left a firm reminder asking students not to ignore lab tidy-up rules.
explanation_ru: Банки исчисляемы («jars»), жидкое мыло измеряют литрами («litres of soap»), а «equipment» неисчисляемое и требует глагол «needs».

prompt: "Our new router sits behind too much heavy (furniture), so our online calls keep freezing in the back bedroom," I told my flatmate in Lisbon. She laughed and stacked three thick (dictionary) beneath the plastic box to lift it above the wooden chest. "Sometimes simple (advice) from a neighbour (work) better than calling technical support," she joked. Surprisingly, the connection became steady right away.
explanation_ru: «Furniture» и «advice» — неисчисляемые существительные (с «advice» нужен глагол «works»), а «three dictionaries» — множественное число исчисляемого существительного.

prompt: Local radio in Bergen has broadcast a coastal warning after three straight days of heavy rainfall across the region. Deep (puddle) currently cover the lower harbour road, slowing down delivery vans and morning buses. According to forecasters, the latest weather (news) (show) that thick coastal fog will remain until late evening. Drivers are advised to allow extra journey time and keep their headlights on.
explanation_ru: Глагол «cover» указывает на множественное число исчисляемого «puddles», а «news» — неисчисляемое и согласуется с глаголом «shows».

prompt: Irene left a bad review because the shop clerk gave her ___ about the cable.
explanation_ru: «Advice» — неисчисляемое существительное: оно не употребляется с «an», «many», «a few» и не имеет формы «advices», поэтому верно «very little useful advice».

prompt: Claire announced that parents donated ___ to our school library in Auckland.
explanation_ru: «Books» — исчисляемое во множественном числе, поэтому «a little», «much» и «an» неверны; с множественным числом подходит «a lot of adventure books».

prompt: Eight of us celebrated my promotion on the patio, but the waiter brought ___ for the huge bowl of dip.
explanation_ru: «Forks» — исчисляемое существительное, поэтому с ним употребляется «a few», а не «a little», «too much» или «less».

prompt: Nadia wrote in the Ottawa gallery guestbook that the crowded rooms did not have ___ for tired visitors.
explanation_ru: С исчисляемым «benches» не используются «much» и «a little», а в отрицании вместо «some» здесь естественно звучит «enough wooden benches».

prompt: Lucas posted a sharp review of the Buenos Aires stadium concert because plain water cost ___ and the seats sat far from the stage.
explanation_ru: Типичная ошибка — переводить «деньги» как множественное число («many money», «moneys»); «money» неисчисляемое, поэтому верно «too much money».

prompt: Writing from a Calgary bank branch, Meera warned managers that the reception area has ___ on busy Monday mornings, forcing older customers to stand.
explanation_ru: «Seating» (сидячие места в целом) — неисчисляемое существительное, поэтому оно не принимает «-s» и сочетается с «too little», а не с «few» или «many».

prompt: Carmen warned the nearby fruit sellers that the fake moneys looked very real.
answer: Carmen warned the nearby fruit sellers that the fake money looked very real.
accepted_answers: Carmen warned the nearby fruit sellers that the fake money looked very real.
explanation_ru: Частая ошибка — добавлять «-s» к слову «money»: это неисчисляемое существительное, поэтому правильно «the fake money».

prompt: We loved the karaoke room in Taipei because the clean furnitures and free tea made everyone feel welcome.
answer: We loved the karaoke room in Taipei because the clean furniture and free tea made everyone feel welcome.
accepted_answers: We loved the karaoke room in Taipei because the clean furniture and free tea made everyone feel welcome.
explanation_ru: Ошибка в форме «furnitures»: слово «furniture» неисчисляемое и никогда не имеет окончания множественного числа.

prompt: Pedro called the relieved tourist with good news that cleaners had found his bag and all three lenses safely inside.
answer: Pedro called the relieved tourist with good news that cleaners had found his bag and all three lenses safely inside.
accepted_answers: Pedro called the relieved tourist with good news that cleaners had found his bag and all three lenses safely inside.
explanation_ru: Ошибки нет: неисчисляемое «good news» употреблено без артикля «a», а исчисляемое «three lenses» стоит во множественном числе.

prompt: Jorge messaged his flatmate in Murcia to complain that noisy birds dropped too much twigs on his clean shirts before flying off with his rice.
answer: Jorge messaged his flatmate in Murcia to complain that noisy birds dropped too many twigs on his clean shirts before flying off with his rice.
accepted_answers: Jorge messaged his flatmate in Murcia to complain that noisy birds dropped too many twigs on his clean shirts before flying off with his rice.
explanation_ru: Ошибка в «too much twigs»: веточки («twigs») — исчисляемое существительное во множественном числе, поэтому требуется «too many».

prompt: After flying to Uppsala for their daughter's ceremony, her parents were upset to learn that students receive less tickets this year than before.
answer: After flying to Uppsala for their daughter's ceremony, her parents were upset to learn that students receive fewer tickets this year than before.
accepted_answers: After flying to Uppsala for their daughter's ceremony, her parents were upset to learn that students receive fewer tickets this year than before.
explanation_ru: Типичная ошибка — использовать «less» с исчисляемым существительным: перед «tickets» нужно сравнительное слово «fewer».

prompt: A landlord in Zurich puts up a polite notice asking tenants to use a small amount of mild soap powder in the shared washing machine. Which sentence fits best?
options: Please put only a few mild soap powder into the machine before starting your wash.
Please put only a little mild soap powder into the machine before starting your wash.
Please put only many mild soap powders into the machine before starting your wash.
Please put only a mild soap powder into the machine before starting your wash.
explanation_ru: «Soap powder» (стиральный порошок) — неисчисляемое вещество, поэтому для значения «немного» верно «a little mild soap powder».

prompt: Sisters reuniting at Copenhagen airport wait behind eighty tourists whose heavy bags slow down the queue. Which sentence is grammatically correct?
options: Although eighty tourists had many luggages, the younger sister quickly spotted her sibling's cardboard sign.
Although eighty tourists had a few heavy luggages, the younger sister quickly spotted her sibling's cardboard sign.
Although eighty tourists had a lot of heavy luggage, the younger sister quickly spotted her sibling's cardboard sign.
Although eighty tourists had much heavy luggages, the younger sister quickly spotted her sibling's cardboard sign.
explanation_ru: «Luggage» — неисчисляемое существительное без формы «luggages», и в утвердительном предложении с ним естественно сочетается «a lot of heavy luggage».

prompt: Anke's shelter has almost no animals left after a busy week. → Anke's shelter has very …
answer: Anke's shelter has very few animals left after a busy week.
accepted_answers: Anke's shelter has very few animals left after a busy week.
explanation_ru: «Animals» — исчисляемое во множественном числе, поэтому значение «почти нет» передаётся через «very few».

prompt: The new market square in Breda has only a little grey concrete around the oak trees. → The new market square in Breda doesn't …
answer: The new market square in Breda doesn't have much grey concrete around the oak trees.
accepted_answers: The new market square in Breda doesn't have much grey concrete around the oak trees.
The new market square in Breda does not have much grey concrete around the oak trees.
explanation_ru: «Concrete» (бетон) — неисчисляемое вещество, поэтому в отрицании «only a little» заменяется на «doesn't have much».
